escalations.title: handlebars 4.0.0–4.7.8 — JavaScript Injection via AST Type Confusion
escalations.description: Remote attacker can inject arbitrary JavaScript via @partial-block tampering if handlebars processes user-controlled template strings. Enables arbitrary code execution on the backend server.
escalations.fix: Upgrade handlebars to 4.7.9+ in Source/Backend. Verify usage: grep -r 'handlebars' Source/Backend/src

escalations.title: protobufjs ≤7.5.7 — Arbitrary Code Execution
escalations.description: Remote attacker achieves arbitrary code execution via malformed protobuf definitions. Orchestrator compromise means full pipeline takeover. Note: platform/ is solo-session only per CLAUDE.md.
escalations.fix: cd platform/orchestrator && npm install protobufjs@^7.5.8 --save && npm audit fix

p1_findings.title: Traceability enforcer has dangerous auto-selection blind spot
p1_findings.description: Without --plan flag, enforcer picks the most recently modified requirements.md (currently self-judging-workflow, 100% passing) and silently skips 4 other plans with 61 unimplemented FRs. CI gate shows green when it should fail.
p1_findings.recommendation: Change CI to iterate all Plans/*/requirements.md files. Quick fix: for plan in Plans/*/; do [ -f "${plan}requirements.md" ] && python3 tools/traceability-enforcer.py --file "${plan}requirements.md" || true; done

p1_findings.title: Primary specification has zero source implementation traces (0/69 FRs)
p1_findings.description: The authoritative domain spec defines 69 FRs for a Feature Request/Bug/Dev Cycle platform with zero source implementation. The actual product (work-item routing engine) traces to a different spec. This is a governance issue requiring a team decision.
p1_findings.recommendation: Team decision required: (a) retire/move to Specifications/roadmap/, (b) rewrite spec to match actual product, or (c) create implementation plans for each unimplemented FR group.

p2_findings.title: FR namespace fragmentation breaks cross-plan traceability
p2_findings.description: Three incompatible FR naming conventions coexist: FR-WF-XXX, FR-dependency-XXX, and FR-001..FR-069. The FR-dependency-* IDs used in source have no matching plan file, causing false enforcer failures for implemented features.
p2_findings.recommendation: Standardise on FR-{short-plan-slug}-{NNN} format. Update Plans/dependency-linking/requirements.md to use FR-dependency-XXX IDs that source already carries.

p2_findings.title: NFR coverage has zero traceability
p2_findings.description: Three non-functional requirements (NFR-1: pipeline timing, NFR-2: additive phases, NFR-3: graceful degradation) have no source traceability. The enforcer regex FR-[A-Z0-9-]+ structurally excludes NFR- prefixed IDs.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add NFR-[0-9]+ to enforcer pattern. Add // Verifies: NFR-X comments in E2E/pipeline configuration.

p2_findings.title: eslint-disable in two production source files (react-hooks/exhaustive-deps)
p2_findings.description: Both files suppress react-hooks/exhaustive-deps without explanation. This rule prevents stale closure bugs in useEffect. Suppression without documentation is a latent correctness risk and an architecture rule violation.
p2_findings.recommendation: Refactor effects to satisfy the dependency rule, or add dated comments explaining why suppression is safe.

p2_findings.title: Duplicate frontend test files for same components
p2_findings.description: Root-level and tests/pages/ copies of same test files both run on npm test. Ambiguity about canonical version; potential duplicate coverage counts.
p2_findings.recommendation: Designate tests/pages/ as canonical. Delete stale root-level duplicates after confirming coverage parity.

p3_findings.title: DebugPortalPage lacks valid FR traceability
p3_findings.recommendation: Add page to a spec with proper FR ID or mark as infrastructure exempt.

p3_findings.title: tiered-merge-pipeline NFRs have no enforcement path
p3_findings.recommendation: Move NFR verification to E2E tests or document CI runtime evidence as verification.

p3_findings.title: 3 approved plans with unimplemented requirements (54 FRs)
p3_findings.recommendation: Triage each plan: confirm in-progress / deferred / cancelled; update plan STATUS field accordingly.

p3_findings.recommendation: Remove fallback or add env-guard that warns/errors in non-development mode.

p3_findings.fix: npm install uuid@^14.0.0 (major version bump — test API compat)

p3_findings.title: qs 6.11.1–6.15.1 query string DoS via null/undefined arrays
p3_findings.fix: npm install qs@^6.15.2 or npm audit fix --force

brace-expansion <1.1.13 process hang on zero-step sequences
vitest 0.0.1–3.0.0-beta.4 transitive vulnerabilities via vite/esbuild chain
Outdated major versions — uuid 9→14, vite 5→8, dockerode 4→5, express version skew

p3_findings.title: No npm audit gate in CI/CD — P1/P2 CVEs can merge undetected
p3_findings.recommendation: Add npm audit --audit-level=high as mandatory CI gate that fails the build.

p4_findings.title: License compliance cannot be audited without npm install
p4_findings.recommendation: Add npx license-checker --json --production to CI after npm install step.

p4_findings.title: pino and prom-client maintenance cadence not monitored
p4_findings.recommendation: Add to dependency watch list. Set up Dependabot or Snyk for continuous monitoring.
